record.what_it_does: Ahrefs provides SEO, backlink, keyword research, rank tracking, site audit, and AI-search-visibility data through a REST API (v3).
record.auth_notes: Direct API/MCP access uses a static per-workspace API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. Building a third-party app that acts on behalf of other Ahrefs users ('Ahrefs Connect') uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE; access tokens last 1 year and no refresh tokens are issued.
record.access_notes: Direct API key access requires a paid Lite-or-higher subscription (self-serve once you pay, plus limited free test queries). Building a public multi-user integration via Ahrefs Connect (OAuth2) requires applying to the program, vendor review/approval of the app (including demonstrating secure token handling), and production usage requires an Enterprise subscription.
record.main_blocker: Multi-user OAuth integration (Ahrefs Connect) requires app review and an Enterprise plan for production; direct API/MCP requires a paid Lite+ subscription
